text:
noah: Heads up — multiple preemptions in us-east-1 at 01:12. Thinking about adding a proactive "hedge" path: move at-risk in-flight work to warm/reserved before term. Quick thoughts?
emma: We have spot-notice (120s) + predictive preempt_score. Preempt_score is noisy but gives lead time.
li: Cost is main worry. Migration adds reserved spend + duplicate work risk. Need an expected-value gate.
rachel: Gate idea: migrate iff preempt_p * expected_redo_cost > migration_cost. expected_redo = remaining_tokens*token_cost + latency_penalty.
noah: Also consider remaining_eta > 90s and tenant has burst_quota. Avoid migrating everything.
emma: Two-tier transfer: try warm-resume first (transfer KV + context), fallback to full reserved slot if not available.
li: Operator pattern: control-plane emits Recommendation (score, ttl), operator rechecks admission and executes. Operator stays stateless.
orch-bot: rollout-bot: feature_flag=preempt_hedge_v0 target=staging 25%
noah: Observability: migrations_triggered, migrations_rejected_admission, migration_success_pct, post_migrate_latency_p95, cost_delta_by_tenant, trace links.
rachel: Rollout: internal canary -> 48h monitor -> 5% tenants -> expand. Circuit-breaker: auto-disable if weekly cost delta > 4% or success < 90%.
emma: Sim plan: replay traces, inject preempts (bernoulli/poisson), model warm pool hitrate and costs; tune threshold.
li: Add per-request cooldown (5m) and per-tenant rate limit and global max_migrations_per_minute to avoid storms.
noah: I'll write RFC with decision fn, proto, sim harness, rollout checklist. Ping infra/billing. :+1:
